# Stamp Duty Australia

> Independent calculator of stamp duty (transfer duty, land transfer duty, conveyance duty) in the eight Australian states and territories, at 2026-27 rates, published by Radif Partners. Every rate, threshold, first home concession, First Home Owner Grant and foreign buyer surcharge is read on the revenue office's own page and dated; the engine is tested against Revenue NSW's and the State Revenue Office Victoria's calculators.

## Calculators
- [Compare all eight states](/): one price, eight jurisdictions, ranked
- [NSW](/nsw/), [Victoria](/vic/), [Queensland](/qld/), [Western Australia](/wa/), [South Australia](/sa/), [Tasmania](/tas/), [ACT](/act/), [Northern Territory](/nt/)
